name: mflow-marketplace
description: Plugins for anyone building a system with AI (an SA, a PM or the system owner): a screen-first, spec-driven workflow and a Thai-capable knowledge base.

plugins.name: mflow
plugins.description: Screen-first, spec-driven workflow: AGENTS.md + OpenSpec + Backlog.md + tests, with session memory hooks and hotspot charting for big business logic.

plugins.name: tamra
plugins.description: Tamra knowledge base: connects the Tamra MCP server (URL and token asked at install); search, save, read and revise knowledge, and with an owner token manage spaces, tags, archive and withdraw.
